_provenance: zeguz, created 2026-08-28 SOLELY as an OTOS diagnostic target. zeguz is the bench rig whose OTOS was last demonstrated good; it is being flashed with pxt-nezha-diffdrive firmware to answer one question -- does OUR OTOS driver work against a KNOWN-GOOD sensor? RUN:probe permanently bricks vevov and tovez (3 reproductions 2026-08-28), and we cannot tell a driver defect from a dead sensor without a working reference. NOTHING here is a measurement: no geometry, vision or calibration value below has been measured on zeguz, and none may be read as if it had. There is deliberately NO geometry.firmware_bake block, so the build keeps motion_engine.h's defaults.

connection._radio_note: Channel and group are derived from the name and probably should not be changed.

vision._tag_note: UNASSIGNED -- zeguz is a bench rig, not a field robot.

geometry._provenance: UNMEASURED placeholders matching motion_engine.h's defaults. zeguz is not driven; these exist only so the file validates.
